en: Sepia-toned historic photograph showing two children and an adult street vendor in traditional East Asian (likely Korean) clothing. The central child stands beside a large A‑frame carrying rack piled high with vegetables or greens, with shallow trays of small goods (possibly food or wares) suspended in front. Another child at left carries a similar tray. In the background are low traditional tile-roofed buildings and another adult wearing a broad conical or mushroom-shaped hat. The scene appears to be an old street-market setting. Small numbers are printed in the lower corners of the image.
